meta.title: LCARS theme
meta.description: Repaints the DeepSeek Harness web interface in the LCARS console style of Star Trek: The Next Generation. A flat black navigation column whose blocks are two label lines tall at 0.9 density (labels end on the right edge, trailing icons hidden, 8px gaps), a full-width brand block carrying the uppercase DEEPSEEK wordmark, a session header of compact rounded blocks (session title, agent mode, subagent and background-task status), a conversation area framed by a 2px console outline that also clips the transcript, and a persistent bottom bar with a pale readout box showing the stardate and the clock. The console face is LCARS GTJ3 for Latin and Glow Sans SC Condensed Bold for Han, carried on the theme's chrome (navigation column, panel top bar and chips, composer stats row, caption menu, bottom readout); the conversation and the composer keep the app's own font, and code blocks keep the app's code font. The black console is the default: the theme registers a dark theme and takes over the Appearance preference, so the app switches its own dark styles instead of only being repainted. Settings › LCARS theme is a page of its own: five colour series (blue console plus 2357, 2369, 2375 and 2379), one adjustable colour per solid block, the sidebar face (LCARS GTJ3, the theme's condensed face or the system font), the black-console switch (turn it off to follow Appearance, where light is a warm PADD-daylight variant), and the chrome and stardate switches; all of them are saved in your profile. Only the web interface is themed, and another theme plugin enabled at the same time competes with this one.
